m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Mandrake Root? Wizard City ran out of it years ago. I think the Gobblers gobbled up as much as they could find.
But I know it can still be found on MooShu, though I am not sure where. You may check with a shopkeeper there named Samoosuke.
So, Professor Ambrose sent you? I am honored; he is a man of great wisdom. You are on a quest for Mandrake root?
I can help with that. Seek out Angoro at his tower in Kishibe Village. He knows where it grows wild.
I am honored to have a visitor from Wizard City. I would gladly invite you for tea in my tower but I cannot.
I have been driven out of my tower by Kuragaso, a bandit who aims to control this region. If you defeat him, you can help yourself to the Mandrake.
So, you found some mandrake. I trust it wasn't too hard to come by... <ITALICS>Cyrus winks knowlingly...</ITALICS>
What are you asking about? I've already instructed you on your quest. Begone! Don't make me turn you into a newt!
I'm going to make a Myth student out of you yet, even if it kills you.
Yes, I'm kidding. But this next spell will challenge you. It will link you to your mythic elemental that you must summon.
You will need Mandrake Root, a plant which I have not seen in years. You may want to ask Ambrose where it grows these days.
